macro: persistent wrong registry -> pre-chapter gate -> textbook lookup -> same-question retry
principles: Any question missed at least once remains in the permanent wrong-answer registry even after later mastery.
Before Day 2-18 starts, up to three wrong questions from any earlier Day can be resurfaced regardless of current chapter topic.
A repeated wrong in the gate must not reveal the answer, explanation, recovery clue, O/X answer, or answer keyword before textbook lookup.
Textbook page numbers are never fabricated.
After textbook lookup, the learner retries the same original question; brief explanation is allowed only after a correct retry.
A later source-learning wrong reopens a previously resolved registry record.
A chapter-gate pass is valid only for the exact source-wrong revision that existed when the learner passed it.
Gate attempts must never mutate the normal Day1-6 source-learning mastery/wrongNote/attempt state.

day1_to_day6.policy: Use audited problem ID -> page/question-number mappings where page exists.

day7_to_day18.policy: Do not guess pages; show unit -> chapter -> section/list only.

locator.gate_answer_leak_policy: Locator guide is rendered with includeKeywords=false before the learner answers correctly.

registry.retention: Records are never deleted on mastery; status changes between open/book-retry/recurring/resolved.
registry.reopen_policy: If a source-learning wrong occurs after resolvedAt, resolvedAt is cleared and the record reopens.
registry.source_revision: sourceRevisionBefore(targetDay) fingerprints only uid + source wrongCount + source lastWrongAt. Gate attempts do not independently invalidate a pass.

pre_chapter_gate.selection: up to three historical wrongs from earlier Days
pre_chapter_gate.bypass_prevention: guard is attached to actual Day entry pages, not only the hub
pre_chapter_gate.pass_policy: PASS stores the current source-wrong revision. If earlier-Day source wrong history changes, the old PASS is invalid.
pre_chapter_gate.session_policy: Gate session stores the same revision. A revision mismatch rebuilds the selected wrong list.

day1_to_day6.policy: Reuse the existing original question UI and isCorrect() only. The gate replaces checkAnswer() with an isolated gate-only verdict path so normal source attempts/problemStatus/wrongNotes are not mutated.
day1_to_day6.book_evidence: bookSeen persists across retry and is recorded when the learner eventually answers correctly after textbook lookup.

day7_to_day18.policy: Use a dedicated gate engine and the same patched content/answer pipeline; normal history2-fast-day-* state is not mutated.

after_correct: record whether textbook lookup was used
return to pre-chapter gate for next historical wrong

integration.load_order: textbook locator -> wrong registry -> registry sync -> gate guard
integration.firebase: history2-wrong-answer-registry-v1 matches the generic history2-* sync prefix and is eligible for existing release Firebase sync

fixed_defects.result: resolved historical wrongs reopen when a newer source-learning wrong occurs
stale chapter PASS and stale gate sessions are invalidated when source wrong history changes

fixed_defects.problem: Day1-6 gate reused the normal checkAnswer(), so a gate retry could mutate normal attempts/problemStatus/wrongNotes and recursively change the source-wrong revision.
fixed_defects.fix: Gate mode now overrides checkAnswer() with an isolated isCorrect()-based verdict and never calls normal saveState/remote attempt mutation for the gate answer.

fixed_defects.problem: bookUsed evidence could be cleared at retry before the eventual correct answer.
fixed_defects.fix: bookSeen now persists across the retry cycle and success wording distinguishes first-try success from textbook-assisted recovery.

static_checks: Day1-6 original metacog source files are real non-empty pages; earlier empty connector output was a fetch representation issue, not a zero-byte file.
Day1-6 exact locator comes from QUESTION_SOURCE_MAPPING_AUDIT.json.
Day7-18 fallback has page=null and verified=false.
gate locator suppresses answer keywords before correct retry.
Day1-6 gate no longer mutates source-learning attempts/problemStatus/wrongNotes.
Day7-18 gate uses its dedicated engine and does not mutate normal fast-day state.
registry sync completes before pre-chapter guard runs.
new source wrong history changes the revision; gate-only counters do not.
qa.limitation: No interactive browser with the learner's real localStorage/Firebase account state is available in this environment. This is integrated static/runtime-code QA, not a claimed visual click-through.
